episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Because of a misunderstanding, Da Yeol gets involved with Tae Hyun, a mischievous classmate who begins to pester him. This is the start of their ill-fated relationship.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Tae Hyun keeps showing up at Da Yeol's side every day. Although Da Yeol hates it, he seems to be growing more concerned about Tae Hyun.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Da Yeol and Tae Hyun are locked inside the gym equipment storage room, what will happen when the two of them are forced to be together?

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Facing questions from Da Yeol, Tae Hyun finally expresses his past; one that he never wanted to face again.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: With the final of the archery competition coming up, will Da Yeol be able to compete without being distracted by external forces?

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Da Yeol ultimately lost the competition, and his relationship with Tae Hyun reaches a bottleneck.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: While Da Yeol studies hard for the police exam, Tae Hyun gives him a secret surprise.
